unique_variable: flip data-bit of value 8 at target-word input, first or second; compare same role/anchor/prefix per pair
primary_gate: At least two of three tied seeds: test 4 pairs of new-first role with >=3/4 positive target bit1 margin deltas while >=3/4 newly flipped target bits still incorrect. This distinguishes weak-but-aligned readout from no positive readout effect, not a proof of cause.
limitations: All IDs are previously analyzed; diagnostic split not untouched blind. SLE Q39 native 01, A two 6-bit words + external S. Each pair holds 1-bit target output prefix fixed. No training or free generation this run; no model/student oracle.
